title: Light Airy Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A jammy and shaggy Vietnamese dish featuring elderflower and mantecare emulsification, perfect for a brunch mood, and is dairy free friendly.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook until fragrant.
Add the tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the elderflower syrup, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour the syrup mixture over the tofu and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the tofu and syrup mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
